manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 229
text:
Page 001
001-1. junitius junitius TS PR
001-2. junitius junitius CL/RD TL Paragon Scans
001-3. discord.gg/pErHvcxdrx

Page 002
002-1. XU QING AND THE SECURITY GUARD ARE REALLY FAMILIAR WITH EACH OTHER.
002-2. HE RARELY COMES INTO CONTACT WITH MANY PEOPLE WITH HIS WORK. THOSE FRIENDS OF HIS ARE VERY BUSY AND FAR AWAY.IF HE STAYS AT HOME FOR A LONG TIME, HE'LL COME OUT FOR SOME AIR. HE MIGHT BE LONELY.
002-3. LONELY? HOW COME I SEE HIM QUITE CAPABLE AT TALKING A LOT ON STREAM?
002-4. THAT'S WORK.. DOYOU STILL WANT TO GET TO KNOW HIM?
002-5. DIDN'TI JUST Do THAT? I JUST DIDN'T ADD HIS WECHAT YET!
002-6. WHAT ARE YOU TRYING TO ADO MY BOYFRIEND ON WECHAT FOR?
002-7. CAN'T HAVE FRIENDS OF THE OPPOSITE SEX ANYMORE?

Page 003
003-1. HMPH!
003-2. I GUESS I REALLY HAVE NO CHANCE TO BEAT HIM TO DEATH!
003-3. BY THE WAY, DIDN'T YOU WANT TO STREAMYOU PLAYING THE GUZHENG? WHERE'S YOUR COMPUTER?
003-4. THE COMPUTER IS IN MY BEDROOM. PUTTING IT IN THE LIVING ROOM IS TROUBLESOME, SINCE I LIKE TO WATCH MOVIES IN BED WHEN I'M TOO LAZY TO GET UP.
003-5. OUR COMPUTERS ARE ALWAYS IN THE LIVING ROOM.WE NEVER BRING IT IN- TO OUR ROOMS
003-6. WHENI HAVE A MAN,I'LL ALSO MOVE MY COM- PUTER OUT!
003-7. T/N: Sign me up! ;)
003-8. THERE SEEMS TO BE NOTHING GOOD ABOUT MEN ANYWAYS.
003-9. IT'S WARMER SLEEPING ON A SINGLE BED, THAT'S ALL.

Page 004
004-1. OKAY,OKAY,CHEF JIANG, SEE WHAT YOU NEED TO BUY, AND I'LL BUY A LITTLE MYSELF TO LEARN HOW TO MAKE IT.
004-2. OKAY!
004-3. I'M HEADING BACK NOW, HIT ME UP AGAIN NEXT TIME!
004-4. OKAY,I'LL SEND YOU THE PICTURES OF THE FOOD.
004-5. I'M BACK!
004-6. DONT YOU THINK WINTER MELON SHOULD EAT MORE SIMPLE? CAT FOOD DOES NOT SEEM VERY HEALTHY.

Page 005
005-1. TRUE...
005-2. SAY,
005-3. PINGPING WAS WEARING HIGH HEELS, MAKING THE CLICK CLACK NOISES...
005-4. DO YOU REALLY LIKE THAT?
005-5. IS SHE PRE- PARING TO BUY A PAIR AND WEAR THEM HERSELF..

Page 006
006-1. OR IS SHE PREPARING TO GIVE ME A TASTE OF "NINE YIN WHITE BONE CLAW" IF I SAY I DO?
006-2. TO LIKE HEELS AND SHOES, YOU MUST LIKE THEIR FEET FIRST.

Page 007
007-1. I DON'T LIKE HERS, SO WHY WOULD I LIKE HER HEELS?
007-2. YOU REALLY DON'T LIKE SHOES?
007-3. IHAVENT WASHED MY HANDS, CHMFI

Page 008
008-1. I JUST LIKE YOURS!
008-2. OKAY,BUT SHE SAID SHE'S INTERESTED IN YOU.
008-3. WHY?

Page 009
009-1. BECALISE OF THAT LIN BLAH BLAH BLAH, ENTHUSATIC CITIZEN BLAH BLAH BLAH...
009-2. AND YOU GETTING TO ME STUDY TO GO TO COL- LEGE,ETC...
009-3. DON'T YOU HAVE ANYTHING TO SAY? FOR EXAMPLE.WHY IS SHE INTERESTED IN YOU? I THINK YOU SHOULD KNOW.
009-4. WHAT IF SHE REALLY LIKES YOU AND WANTS TO BE YOUR CONCUBINE?
009-5. THERE'S NO SUCH THING AS A CONCUBINE NOWI YOU'VE STUDIED FOR NOTHING!
009-6. THERE IS! A FEW DAYS AGO, I SAW A GUY WHO HAS A WHOLE COMMUNITY OF WIVES... EVEN IF IT'S NOT CALLED CONCUBINE ANYMORE, IT'S THE SAME MEANING.

Page 010
010-1. YOU THINK TOO HIGHLY OF ME.IT'S ONLY LIKE THAT BE- CAUSE THE WHOLE COMMUNITYIS OWNED BY THAT PERSON.
010-2. A PERSON LIKE ME WITH NO MONEY AND ASSETS,IT'S ALREADY A BLESSING TO BE ABLE TO MARRY AN ANCIENT WIFE, SO HOW COULD I DARE HAVE A CONCUBINE?
010-3. CHE.
010-4. AFTER PINGPING KNEW THAT YOU WANTEDTOHELP ME GO TO COLLEGE, SHE WANTED TO GET TO KNOW YOU.
010-5. MAYBE IT'S BECAUSE SHE SAW HOW YOU'RE REALLY NICE TO ME.
010-6. OR SHE THNKS I'M HANDSOME.
010-7. THE CAPABLE LITTLE RICHWOMAN LIKES SOMEONE WHO IS HANDSOME AND STRONG LIKE ME.
010-8. STRONG? LET'S HAVE A FIGHT?

Page 011
011-1. IFYOU WANT TO BEAT ME UP, JUST SAY SO.
011-2. CRACKS FROM KNEELING
011-3. PEOPLE WHO PRACTICE MARTIAL ARTSARE REALLY BUILT DIFFERENT. ALTHOUGH HER SMALL HAND IS SOFT, IT HAS POWER.
011-4. IS IT BECALSE YOU HAD FUN LAST NIGHT THAT I'M GETTING THIS SERVICE...

Page 012
012-1. SAY IT AGAIN?
012-2. I DIDN'T LIKE IT!
012-3. IF THIS GUY DARES TO DO IT AGAINI SHOULD CARRY HIM TO THE STORAGE ROOM LIKE A PIGGY!
012-4. MAYBE SHE THOUGHT I WAS GOOD TO YOU, SUCH AS FORCING YOU TO STUDY, AND THEN SHE BECAME CURIOUS. AFTER ALL, HOW CAN A NORMAL MAN FORCE HIS GIRLFRIEND WHO HAS NEVER GONE TO SCHOOL TO CONTINUE GOING TO SCHOOL...
012-5. SURE ENOUGH, MY FEELING IS CORRECT!EVEN WHAT YOU TWO SAY IS SIMILAR.
012-6. UH...BECALISE SHE DOESN'T KNOW THAT YOUR TRUE IDENTITY IS A LITTLE OLD LADY WHO IS OVER A THOUSAND YEARS OLD.
012-7. EXCELLENT
012-8. PARENT
012-9. IF YOU WERE AMODERN PERSON, DATING IS MORE ABOUT FINDING SOMEONE SUITABLE AND EXCLUDING THE UNSUIT- ABLE ONES. THERE ARE VERY FEW PEOPLE LIKE ME WHO RAISE THEIR GIRLFRIEND LIKE A DAUGHTER.
012-10. RAISING AN OLD LADY OVER A THOUSAND YEARS OLD AS A DAUGHTER?

Page 013
013-1. AS A WIFE! AS A WIFE!
013-2. HMPH, WE'RE NOT MARRIED YET.
013-3. DOES IT MATTER IF WE ARE MARRIED OR NOT?
013-4. NIGHT... LAST SAID IT ALL.
